items.evidence: Recursion is basically a function that repeats itself.
items.note: The student mentions a function repeating itself but does not explicitly explain that the function calls itself.
The student did not mention a base case.
The student did not mention how a result is returned without further calls.
The student did not explain that recursive calls operate on a smaller subproblem.
The student did not mention the call stack or stack frames.
The student did not discuss stack overflow errors.
The student did not mention rewriting recursion iteratively.
The student did not explain tail call optimization.

target_reason: A base case is essential for preventing infinite repetition in recursion.
target_focus: how the function knows when to stop repeating
